title: Six architectures, one engine
subtitle: Every facade here was written by an author who could not read the engine - only a brief, a schema, a facet list and two photographs of the mass. Each was given a different architecture to pursue and nothing else. All of them had to pass the design gates AND render before they counted, which is a stricter bar than this project used until today.

candidates.note: A bent-bar terrace bridge: the bar touches the ground at one entrance pier only, everything else cantilevers from z=1.861. 37 facets, widths 0.02 to 5.5 m.
A plain extruded prism: 35 vertices, two z levels, every vertical face a full rectangle, five storeys, sixteen facets. It sits on the ground and it does not step.

sections.title: Six architectures
sections.note: Not six material treatments of one building - six different buildings. The engine, the two masses and the gates are identical across all of them; what differs is what the author was asked to make. Five of the six drew. The sixth, an all-glass skin on the star prism, is not on this page because it never rendered: it cleared every design gate and every elevation and was rejected three times by the plan cut alone. Its author left the most useful result of the day - halving the depth of the members at the seam changed the seam by not one pixel, which is the second independent demonstration that this fault is not a depth anyone can tune.

cards.title: Arched masonry
cards.intent: Load-bearing wall where the arch is structural rather than ornamental - thick wall, deep reveal, openings that change as the load changes up the building.

cards.title: One great opening
cards.intent: The first scheme in this project with two constructions on one building: a unitised curtain wall on the street face, punched masonry behind it, and on the masonry one window 1.2 by 11.85 m - eleven times the area of anything beside it - cutting through four floors.

cards.title: Layered screen
cards.intent: Depth as the whole subject. Glass at 0, transom at 0.08, spandrel at 0.14, mullion at 0.18, fins at 0.32, cornice at 0.85 - a facade that is a section rather than a pattern. Its author found a contradiction in the brief getting here.

cards.title: Inverted weight
cards.intent: Open at the ground and denser as it rises, so the mass is carried above the street. The one scheme where the underside datum is live: a single level soffit line runs under a base that steps four times.

cards.title: Ribbon
cards.intent: Horizontal and nothing else - continuous bands of opening against continuous bands of solid, with no vertical member permitted to read, held level across a mass whose facets begin at seven different heights.
